result: Decomposed the remaining worst-case leaf into giant-quotient primitives, local certificates, certificate aggregation/canonical partitioning, and master quasipolynomial recursion. A synthetic k=20 giant action certified source order 2^20*20!, quotient 20!, and kernel 2^20 using 20 kernel generators without quotient enumeration.
